(function(root){
'use strict';
const E=root.Shade;
function sphere(ctx,x,y,d,ball,colors){
 const layer=document.createElement('canvas');layer.width=Math.ceil(d);layer.height=Math.ceil(d);const p=layer.getContext('2d');
 const color=id=>E.toHex(colors[id]||colors.base),ell=(cx,cy,rx,ry,fill)=>{p.fillStyle=fill;p.beginPath();p.ellipse(cx*d,cy*d,rx*d,ry*d,0,0,Math.PI*2);p.fill();};
 p.fillStyle=color('shadow');p.fillRect(0,0,d,d);p.filter=`blur(${ball.softness/100*d*.045}px)`;
 if(ball.mode==='cel'){ell(.32,.28,.57,.61,color('base'));ell(.14,.08,.32,.33,color('highlight'));}
 else{ell(.83,.38,.65,.72,color('rim'));ell(.88,.35,.64,.70,color('base'));ell(.12,.87,.29,.27,color('bounce'));ell(.70,.12,.20,.17,color('highlight'));}
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+d/2,y+d/2,d/2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.clip();ctx.drawImage(layer,x,y,d,d);ctx.restore();
}
function ballCanvas(canvas,ball,strength=ball.strength){const c=canvas.getContext('2d'),w=canvas.width,h=canvas.height;c.clearRect(0,0,w,h);sphere(c,w*.15,h*.07,Math.min(w*.70,h*.85),ball,E.resolve(ball,strength));}
let triangleCache=null,triangleHue=null;
function triangleRaster(hue){if(triangleCache&&triangleHue===hue)return triangleCache;const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=320;canvas.height=320;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),img=ctx.createImageData(320,320);for(let y=62;y<=258;y++)for(let x=99;x<=248;x++){const l=(1-(y-62)/196)*100,c=(x-99)/149,max=1-Math.abs(2*l/100-1);if(c>max+.001)continue;const rgb=E.hslRgb([hue,max>1e-8?c/max*100:0,l]),i=(y*320+x)*4;img.data.set([...rgb,255],i);}ctx.putImageData(img,0,0);triangleCache=canvas;triangleHue=hue;return canvas;}
function drawWheel(canvas,ball,active,analysisIds){const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.setTransform(2,0,0,2,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,320,320);const colors=E.resolve(ball),h=colors[active]?.[0]??ball.base[0];for(let degree=0;degree<360;degree++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(160,160,142,(degree-90)*Math.PI/180,(degree-88.6)*Math.PI/180);ctx.lineWidth=19;ctx.strokeStyle=E.toHex([degree,100,50]);ctx.stroke();}ctx.drawImage(triangleRaster(Math.round(h)),0,0);const selected=analysisIds.filter(id=>colors[id]),fit=E.fitLine(selected.map(id=>[colors[id][1],colors[id][2]]));ctx.lineWidth=1.3;ctx.strokeStyle='#ffffff90';ctx.beginPath();selected.forEach((id,i)=>{const p=E.trianglePoint(colors[id]);i?ctx.lineTo(...p):ctx.moveTo(...p);});ctx.stroke();
 if(fit){ctx.save();ctx.setLineDash([3,4]);ctx.strokeStyle='#a8f7d9';ctx.beginPath();let started=false;for(let i=0;i<=200;i++){let s,l;if(fit.vertical!==undefined){s=fit.vertical;l=i/2;}else{s=i/2;l=fit.m*s+fit.b;}if(l<0||l>100){started=false;continue;}const p=E.trianglePoint([h,s,l]);started?ctx.lineTo(...p):ctx.moveTo(...p);started=true;}ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
 const markers=[];Object.entries(colors).forEach(([id,color],i)=>{const a=(color[0]-90)*Math.PI/180,r=142+(i%3-1)*3,wp=[160+Math.cos(a)*r,160+Math.sin(a)*r],tp=E.trianglePoint(color);for(const [kind,p] of [['hue',wp],['triangle',tp]]){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(...p,id===active?6:4.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=E.toHex(color);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#0d1015';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle=id===active?'#ffffff':'#ffffffb0';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();markers.push({id,kind,x:p[0],y:p[1]});}});return markers;}
function graph(canvas,ball,ids){const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),w=canvas.width,h=canvas.height;ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);const left=64,top=20,pw=w-88,ph=h-66;ctx.font='24px Segoe UI';ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let t=0;t<=100;t+=25){const x=left+pw*t/100,y=top+ph*(1-t/100);ctx.strokeStyle='#37404d';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,top);ctx.lineTo(x,top+ph);ctx.moveTo(left,y);ctx.lineTo(left+pw,y);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#a6b2c1';ctx.fillText(String(t),x-12,h-14);ctx.fillText(String(t),8,y+8);}const colors=E.resolve(ball),list=ids.filter(id=>colors[id]),fit=E.fitLine(list.map(id=>[colors[id][1],colors[id][2]]));const point=([_,s,l])=>[left+pw*s/100,top+ph*(1-l/100)];ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(left,top,pw,ph);ctx.clip();if(fit){ctx.beginPath();if(fit.vertical!==undefined){ctx.moveTo(left+pw*fit.vertical/100,top);ctx.lineTo(left+pw*fit.vertical/100,top+ph);}else{ctx.moveTo(left,top+ph*(1-fit.b/100));ctx.lineTo(left+pw,top+ph*(1-(100*fit.m+fit.b)/100));}ctx.strokeStyle='#80ddbe';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.setLineDash([6,6]);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);}ctx.strokeStyle='#bec5ce80';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();list.forEach((id,i)=>{const p=point(colors[id]);i?ctx.lineTo(...p):ctx.moveTo(...p);});ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();for(const id of list){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(...point(colors[id]),6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=E.toHex(colors[id]);ctx.fill();ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.stroke();}return fit;}
function exportCanvas(balls,kind,width,background,labels,samples=[]){
 const cols=Math.min(3,Math.max(1,balls.length)),cell=width/cols,pad=cell*.08,ballD=cell*.66;
 const maxRoles=Math.max(1,...balls.map(b=>b.roles.length+1));
 const stripHeight=labels?Math.max(cell*.30,Math.ceil(maxRoles/4)*cell*.17):cell*.12;
 const rowHeight=cell*.13+(kind!=='strips'?cell*.76:0)+(kind!=='balls'?stripHeight:0);
 const rows=Math.ceil(balls.length/cols),canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=width;canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(samples.length?width*.26:rows*rowHeight));const c=canvas.getContext('2d');
 if(background!=='transparent'){c.fillStyle=background==='white'?'#fff':'#161b22';c.fillRect(0,0,width,canvas.height);}const ink=background==='dark'?'#edf2f4':'#172129';
 const text=(s,x,y,size,max)=>{c.fillStyle=ink;c.font=`${size}px Segoe UI`;c.fillText(s,x,y,max);};
 if(samples.length){const sw=width/samples.length;for(let i=0;i<samples.length;i++){c.fillStyle=E.toHex(samples[i]);c.fillRect(i*sw,0,sw,width*.16);if(labels){text(String(i+1),i*sw+8,width*.195,width*.025,sw-10);text(E.toHex(samples[i]),i*sw+8,width*.23,width*.02,sw-10);}}return canvas;}
 balls.forEach((ball,i)=>{const x=(i%cols)*cell,y=Math.floor(i/cols)*rowHeight,colors=E.resolve(ball);if(labels)text(ball.name,x+pad,y+cell*.07,cell*.04,cell-pad*2);let sy=y+cell*.11;if(kind!=='strips'){sphere(c,x+(cell-ballD)/2,sy,ballD,ball,colors);sy+=cell*.73;}if(kind!=='balls'){const entries=Object.entries(colors),per=labels?Math.min(4,entries.length):entries.length,sw=(cell-pad*2)/per;entries.forEach(([id,color],j)=>{const xx=x+pad+(j%per)*sw,yy=sy+Math.floor(j/per)*cell*.17;c.fillStyle=E.toHex(color);c.fillRect(xx,yy,sw-2,cell*.07);if(labels){text(E.roleName(ball,id),xx,yy+cell*.105,cell*.026,sw-4);text(E.toHex(color),xx,yy+cell*.14,cell*.024,sw-4);}});}});return canvas;
}
root.ShadeRender={sphere,ballCanvas,drawWheel,graph,exportCanvas};
})(globalThis);
